title: Prometheus Self-Monitoring (Placeholder - Import from Grafana.com or create custom)
description:
This is a placeholder dashboard. To enable:
1. Uncomment prometheus-self job in prometheus.yml.j2
2. Import dashboard ID 3662 from Grafana.com
3. Or create custom dashboard using Prometheus self-metrics
4. Recommended metrics:
   - Scrape targets: up
   - Scrape duration: prometheus_target_interval_length_seconds
   - Storage: prometheus_tsdb_*
